proposals.name: short-kebab-name
proposals.replaces: What agents do today instead, citing the pattern (e.g. 6 chained grep/sed/cat calls per question, B1/B3/B4).
proposals.trigger: tool: when an agent should call it; hook: the event and matcher, e.g. PostToolUse:Bash; shared-file: when it is regenerated
proposals.input: Exact arguments, stdin or files, with types, e.g. --subject <name> (str), reads icm-project/subjects/<name>.md
proposals.output: Exact stdout or file and format, e.g. JSON {"answer": str, "sources": ["path:line"]}; exit 0/1
proposals.estimate_basis: Arithmetic from digest counts, e.g. B3 128 calls x ~560 tok avg - 80 tok tool output = ...
proposals.test_plan: The unit tests that prove the input→output contract, including one failure case.
proposals.risks: What could go wrong or hide information from the agent, and the mitigation.
